tits.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot has both of its connections to T.I.T.S. working (one to send commands, one to hear hits).

tits.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot was fully connected to T.I.T.S. and one of its two connections drops.

tits.websocketConnected.description: Runs when the connection Cuebot uses to send commands to T.I.T.S. comes up.

tits.websocketDisconnected.description: Runs when the connection Cuebot uses to send commands to T.I.T.S. drops.

tits.eventsConnected.description: Runs when the connection Cuebot uses to hear about hits and triggers from T.I.T.S. comes up.

tits.eventsDisconnected.description: Runs when the connection Cuebot uses to hear about hits and triggers from T.I.T.S. drops.

tits.itemHit.description: Runs when a thrown item hits your avatar in T.I.T.S. Great for a reaction sound or a "ouch!" message.

fields.item: Only react to these items, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item.
fields.trigger: Only react to hits caused by these T.I.T.S. triggers, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.
fields.minStrength: Only react to hits at least this strong. Leave empty to react to every hit.

variables.itemName: The name of the item that hit
variables.triggerName: The name of the trigger that threw it

tits.triggerActivated.description: Runs when a T.I.T.S. trigger starts (the thing that decides when items get thrown).

fields.trigger: Only react to these T.I.T.S. triggers, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.

tits.triggerEnded.description: Runs when a T.I.T.S. trigger finishes.

fields.trigger: Only react to these T.I.T.S. triggers, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.

tits.activateTrigger.description: Starts a T.I.T.S. trigger, which throws items at your avatar the way you set it up in T.I.T.S.

fields.trigger: The trigger's name or id from T.I.T.S.

tits.activateTriggerByName.description: Starts a T.I.T.S. trigger by its name, which throws items at your avatar the way you set it up in T.I.T.S.

fields.trigger: The trigger's name exactly as T.I.T.S. shows it.

tits.throwItem.description: Throws one kind of item at your avatar, one or more times.

fields.delay: How many seconds to wait between throws. T.I.T.S. normally uses 0.05.
fields.amount: How many items to throw in total.
fields.item: The item's name or id from T.I.T.S.

tits.throwItemByName.description: Throws one kind of item, picked by its name, at your avatar, one or more times.

fields.delay: How many seconds to wait between throws. T.I.T.S. normally uses 0.05.
fields.amount: How many items to throw in total.
fields.item: The item's name exactly as T.I.T.S. shows it.

tits.throwItems.description: Throws random items from a list at your avatar. Each throw picks one item from your list.

fields.delay: How many seconds to wait between throws. T.I.T.S. normally uses 0.05.
fields.amount: How many items to throw in total.
fields.items: The items to pick from (names or ids), one per line or separated by commas.

tits.throwItemsByName.description: Throws random items, picked from a list of names, at your avatar. Each throw picks one item from your list.

fields.delay: How many seconds to wait between throws. T.I.T.S. normally uses 0.05.
fields.amount: How many items to throw in total.
fields.items: The item names to pick from, one per line or separated by commas.

tits.getItems.description: Reads the list of items T.I.T.S. can throw and keeps it for later steps.

variables.tits.items: The list of items (id and name) as raw text

tits.getTriggers.description: Reads the list of T.I.T.S. triggers and keeps it for later steps.

variables.tits.triggers: The list of triggers (id and name) as raw text
